'''Bre'ano Umakk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] before the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]], Bre'ano Umakk was discovered by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] at a very young age and was taken to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] where he was to learn the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Later, the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] broke out after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]] happened in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] after [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] had overheard a secret meeting of various heads of major corporations, some of which represented their worlds in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], and formed the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Umakk fought side by side with clones of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="AED" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the last year of the war, it became clear that the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] and leader of the Republic, [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], was known to be the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] Darth Sidious and had influenced the war in his favor in recent years to annihilate the Jedi. Even during the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|fierce battles]] that took hold in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], Palpatine and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who had fallen to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] and become Darth Vader, managed to turn against the Jedi by issuing [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] and pull the Galactic Senate to his side in forming the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Umakk survived the purge and settled on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] where he trained other Jedi, who had survived the purge, in defensive combat throughout the years. He taught others the ways of the Jedi in hopes of destroying those who followed the ways of the dark side.<ref name="AED" />
